name: Build on Windows
on:
  workflow_call:
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-2022
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20.x'
          registry-url: 'https://registry.npmjs.org'
      - name: Install dependencies, build and test. 🔧
        run: .\build.ps1
